title: Meu Pé de Laranja Lima
writer: Braz Chediak, Aurélio Teixeira, José Mauro de Vasconcelos
actors: Júlio César Cruz, Aurélio Teixeira, Henrique José Leal
plot: Poor boy treats a sweet lemon tree as his only friend, talking to it, and learning important values in the process. But one day the tree must be cut.
